# caption_prompts

**In one sentence:** a small library of named caption prompts that you can save once and reuse in every project.

## Why it exists
Captioning (CaptionBboxStep) asks a vision-language model to describe each image using a text
prompt. Instead of retyping good prompts per project, they are saved by name and picked from a
list in the UI.

## What's inside
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `prompt_registry.py` | `CaptionPrompt` plus `list_prompts`, `load`, `save`, `delete` for prompts of a given kind. |

## How it works
- Two kinds (`KINDS`): `full_image` (whole picture) and `region` (a box inside the picture).
- Each prompt is one YAML file `<kind>__<slug>.yaml`, so the same name can exist for both kinds.
- A built-in read-only prompt named `Default` is not stored on disk; its text comes from
  `steps/caption_bbox/prompts.py` so the UI default and runtime default never drift. It cannot be overwritten or deleted.
- `delete` is idempotent (deleting a missing prompt is fine).

## Who uses it
- `prepare_lora_kit_ui/bridge.py` — `list_caption_prompts`, save and delete bridge calls for the UI prompt picker.
- `project/config_schema/fields.py` — the `_prompt` field type is "backed by" this library in the UI.
- Tests: `tests/caption_prompts/test_registry.py`

## Good to know
- Prompts are stored in the **repo checkout** at `configs/caption_prompts/` (`paths.CONFIGS_DIR`),
  not under `~/.prepare_lora_kit/` like projects and settings. A re-clone loses saved prompts.
